QuestInfo.name: Gaga's Alibi
QuestInfo.1: Gaga claims that he never saw Cassandra's letter. However, he sounds suspicious. Go back to Cassandra, deliver Gaga's message and consult her.\nWatch out! She'll probably get even angrier.\n
QuestInfo.2: Having heard Gaga's claim that he never even saw the letter, Cassandra is furious like the exploding El Nath Volcano.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 200\n\nCan proceed to the Truth Lollipop and Gaga quest

0.0: P-please tell C-Cassandra that I've never seen this letter... Erm, please excuse me. I am kind of busy...\n#b(He pretends to be busy while avoiding eye contact with you, but all he's doing is walking in circles.)

1.0: So, what did Gaga say? Did you get my letter back? \r\n#L0##bGaga told me that he's never seen the letter... Are you sure the letter disappeared after Gaga came by? Maybe you misplaced it...#l\n#k
1.1: That's what Gaga told you? NO! Gaga! I will never forgive him! I'm absolutely, 1,000% certain. It's him. He stole it. Did Gaga stutter when he talked to you?\r\n#L0##bA-a little. He stuttered and tried to avoid eye contact with me. He looked kind of nervous...#l\n#k
1.2: See? That's what Gaga does when he lies. How dare he lie to me! If this is what Gaga wants, then I have plans of my own!

npc.0: I t-told you.  I d-don't know anything about the letter. P-please tell C-Cassandra that I've never seen it before... Now, please excuse me. I am kind of busy...\n#b(He pretends to be busy while avoiding eye contact with you, but all he's doing is walking in circles.)
